$$ c(T\mathbb{CP}^\infty) = (1+H)^{\mathbb{Z}} \quad \text{(formally)} $$
More precisely, the total Chern class of $\mathbb{CP}^n$ is given by:
$$ c(T\mathbb{CP}^n) = (1+H)^{n+1} = \sum_{k=0}^{n+1} \binom{n+1}{k} H^k $$
